Dashboard: Officer Login, Pre-Login Data, the Sheet's Words

The proposed website Dashboard, 6 Oct 2026, branch feat/dashboard-audit-fixes. Before is commit 3080e862; After is this change. 1440px. The last three panels compare the citizen view (left) with the officer view (right), or the login page in two states.

Top of the dashboard

Before
No way for an officer to sign in; the lead figure read "people reached by Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan"
After
An Officer Login button at the top right; the lead figure reads "Total Outreach", the sheet's name, with the programme named under it
Why
The dashboard has its own login (decided 6 Oct); every label is the sheet's.

Dashboards by Portal (citizen view)

Before
Five portal cards including DAPSC and SHRESHTA; SMILE printed conversion % (an officer KPI); Senior Citizens showed its budget and spend (officer KPIs); labels in our own words
After
Three cards: NMBA, SMILE – Beggary, Senior Citizens Welfare. SMILE shows counts only and its two public fund figures; Senior Citizens shows its Pre-Login KPIs; every label is the KPI's name in the sheet
Why
Portal data for these three only, for now; a citizen never sees a Post-Login KPI.

Fund Release and Expenditure (citizen view)

Before
Included "Expenditure as a Share of Budget Estimate" for the Senior Citizens components
After
Share of Fund Release only
Why
The sheet marks every Budget Estimate, Expenditure and Financial Progress row Official (Post-Login).

SMILE – Beggary: citizen vs officer

Citizen
Citizen: the three stage counts and bars
Officer
Officer, after sign-in: the same, with each stage's conversion %
Why
Conversion is KPIs 23 and 24, Office (Post-Login).

Senior Citizens Welfare: citizen vs officer

Citizen
Citizen: Pre-Login KPIs only
Officer
Officer: plus the spend against Budget Estimate
Why
Budget KPIs are Official (Post-Login) in the sheet.

Officer Login page (new)

Empty
Submitted empty: each field says what is missing
Filled
Filled in: Sign In opens the officer view
Why
A prototype of the screen: nothing is sent or checked.
